description: linear-heads-scores@1 with the cell field sinks (DR-229, Vektoren und Scores in einem Lauf in zwei Stores schreiben), class D: three absolute costs, each from text to durably closed stores, one arm per cell, median and IQR, never compared with each other, summed or turned into a factor. heads-sinks-both writes a ShardSink of the vectors and a ScoreSink of the scores of two softmax heads in one pass, heads-sinks-vectors only the ShardSink (both with return_vectors, so the heads on raw means take the unfolded path), heads-score-sink-full only the ScoreSink on the folded path (the cell of DR-162). Ordered document IDs and durability full; the timer is continuous over opening the sinks, the complete run and every close; every store is verified, synchronized and removed outside the timer, its tensors hashed against the same run without a sink. Run all three with --local-phase descriptive --descriptive-repetitions 5. M1 local indication only, no README speed claims.
